subject: [RFC PATCH 28/57] mm/collapse: remove the mechanism the engine replaces

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch removes the mechanism that the new engine replaces in the mm/collapse code. The old anonymous collapse functionality is no longer needed as its entry point was rewired to the new engine, and all functions below it lost their last caller. The patch deletes a chain of functions including scan, mTHP order walk, collapse itself, isolation, swap-in, copy with success and failure paths, PTE release helpers, folio_pte_referenced(), and pmd-still-valid check. However, some functions like alloc_charge_folio() and hugepage_vma_revalidate() are left intact as they are still called by file paths and MADV_COLLAPSE. Four tracepoints also lose their only emitter but their definitions remain in the code.
